comments.value: I reviewed multiple output logs. They do not contain a single fatal exception immediately preceding the freeze. Instead, sessions either stop abruptly or show unrelated null-reference/resource errors. This appears consistent with a lower-level GPU driver hang rather than a clean in-engine crash. Recurrent log details include Using PostPresentHandoff/AMD workaround: False, repeated desktop-mode OpenVR init failures, occasional UI/resource missing messages, and some null-reference exceptions in UI/audio shutdown paths.

details:
**Summary:**

VRChat causes a non-recoverable GPU driver hang on AMD RX 7900 XTX requiring a full system reboot. This occurs in desktop mode and is isolated to VRChat (other GPU-intensive applications remain stable.)

**System Specifications:**

* CPU: Ryzen 9 9950X

* GPU: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (XFX MERC)

* RAM: 96GB DDR5 (2×48GB)

* Storage: Samsung 980 Pro 2TB NVMe

* Motherboard: MSI MPG X870 Gaming Carbon WiFi

* PSU: 1000W

* OS: Windows 11

**Displays:**

* 4K @ 60Hz (primary)

* 1440p @ 144Hz FreeSync (secondary)

**Driver Version:**

* AMD Adrenalin 26.2.2

**Issue Behavior:**

* Screen freezes or turns black

* Audio continues (game + Discord)

* Microphone may still transmit

* Win + Ctrl + Shift + B does not recover the driver

* Requires hard reboot

**Frequency:**

* Intermittent

* Can occur within minutes OR after 1–3+ hours of gameplay

**Steps to Reproduce:**

1. Launch VRChat in desktop mode

2. Join any world

3. Play normally

4. After some time, GPU driver freezes and system becomes unrecoverable

**Troubleshooting Performed:**

* Cleared VRChat cache

* Cleared DirectX shader cache

* Verified stability in other games (FFXIV, Cyberpunk 2077)

* No overclocking or undervolting (stock GPU/CPU settings)

* Normal temps and power draw

* Ran SMART checks on SSD (no issues)

* Ran DISM and SFC (no integrity violations)

**Additional Notes:**

* Issue occurs only in VRChat

* System is otherwise stable under heavy GPU load

* Behavior suggests a hard driver hang rather than recoverable timeout (TDR)

* Possible relation to shader compilation, avatar loading, or VRAM usage over time
title: Hard GPU driver freeze requiring reboot on AMD 7900 XTX (Adrenalin 26.2.2)
